what_this_is: Every path under E:/labcairn-local that a tracked file names, and what each one is expected to be: present, renamed (with the path that replaced it), or absent. The rule it encodes: a rename is not a defect, a bare pointer to the old name is. The half that needs the packs runs on a development machine; the half that only needs the tree runs in CI.
